text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Swedish and Mozambican governments signed three cooperation agreements in Maputo on Thursday whereby Sweden is to grant aid worth about $18.4 million for the period 1997 to 1999.
- Prime Minister Pascoal Mocumbi is to visit areas around the Pungue, Buzi and Zambezi rivers in central Mozambique to see the extent of flooding which has left thousands of families homeless.
